MILO

A mobile teddy-bear companion designed to make everyday life safer and friendlier for older adults.

Where it stands
In development. Mobility, voice interaction, reminders, sensing and alert integration are planned prototype features; completed end-to-end operation has not been verified.

A closer look

THE SPARK

Why this one?

Technology can feel intimidating when it is supposed to make daily life easier. MILO starts with a familiar teddy-bear form and asks how an approachable robot could support older adults without making companionship feel clinical.

THE BUILD

How it works

In development: a low-cost mobile teddy-bear-inspired robot on an RC car platform. The intended prototype combines ESP32-based embedded electronics, voice interaction, medication reminders, wearable-based fall and vital-sign monitoring, camera-assisted awareness, obstacle sensing and emergency alerts. These functions are design goals and are not all implemented or validated yet.

ESP32 · IoT · Embedded systems · Computer vision · Python

THE COMPONENTS

Inside the project

  • RC car–based mobile teddy-bear companion with voice interaction
  • Planned reminders, fall/vital-sign monitoring and caregiver alerts
  • Low-cost embedded vision and obstacle-detection integration

CURRENT CHAPTER

Progress & evidence

Concept and prototype integration in progress; a complete public demonstration is not yet available.
